item.title: Version 1.0.0-beta.2 (73)
item.description:
Trails RG Studio 1.0.0-beta.2

Build 73

  • Scenes explains why a frame was accepted or rejected, and that note stays with the cull.
  • The focus ring sits on the photo, and scrolling the list updates the frame on the right.
  • A Thorough cull looks again in four parts of the frame when no animal was named.
  • See trailsrg.com/apps/studio/versions for full notes
